description: This file defines the Headers class used for managing HTTP headers in the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It includes methods for marshalling, unmarshalling, and manipulating headers.

classes.name: Headers
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP headers, including serialization and deserialization methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Headers object with an optional array of headers.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the headers into a string buffer using encoding.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes a buffer into a Headers object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific header.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates the value for a specific header.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the headers as an associative array.
